name: Salyut 7
dispatch: Salyut 7 was the last Salyut and the bridge to Mir — and the setting for the hardest repair job ever attempted in orbit. In 1985, after the abandoned station fell silent, frozen, and slowly tumbling, two cosmonauts flew up, manually docked with the dead and unpowered hulk, and brought it back to life by hand, thawing it out and restarting its systems one by one. Salyut 7 carried the two-port, Progress-resupplied architecture to full maturity and handed it, essentially complete, to the modular station that would replace it.
description: The last Salyut, in service 1982–1991. Famously revived by Vladimir Dzhanibekov and Viktor Savinykh in 1985 after losing power and tumbling — the first orbital salvage mission. Reentered uncontrolled in 1991 over Argentina.
